# Magic Studio

Run `cargo run --release -p magic` for the pure-Rust `eframe` + `egui` 0.37 desktop coordinator.
Discover operations with `magic-cli --help` and `magic-cli commands`. Ask when the goal or a choice
is unclear. For coding, follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md), and
[architecture](../docs/architecture.md). Consult [the control protocol](../docs/control-protocol.md)
and [MCP guide](../docs/mcp.md) when driving a live `magic --control 9875` window.
